notes.title: Soundtrack Now Available!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! I wanted to quickly announce that the soundtrack for Fling with a Tiefling has dropped! This OST is priced at $2.99 and contains six tracks, three from the original game and three brand-new tracks composed just for this soundtrack, hence why it's aptly named "Extended Soundtrack."[/p][p]This OST contains .OGG, .MP3, and .WAV files for each song, though .WAV can only be accessed if you've turned on the option to download high-quality audio files in your Steam settings. If you aren't sure how to do that, I've provided a quick step-by-step guide on the soundtrack's store page![/p][p]Right now, the OST is 20% off until June 13![/p][p]Thank you all for your love and support on Fling with a Tieflin![/p]
